purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche D player-language benchmark for terse, ordinary table questions. Semantic criteria grade gameplay meaning rather than literal phrasing.
blindnessPolicy: Do not edit this tranche after its first paid live run except to preserve an immutable record of what was run.
Any failed tranche-D case may become a regression after diagnosis, but it may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche D, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.
These questions were authored after r14 was merged and must not be used to tune r14 before the first live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C questions.

cases.question: im defending but its not my land. tie means i win right?

semanticCriteria.statement: The defender does not win a tied battle merely for being the defender when they lack Defensive Edge.

cases.question: we already played gambits then the fight ended no winner. where do the cards go

semanticCriteria.statement: After Onset, when a battle ends without a winner, committed cards and remaining Reserve cards are cleared normally unless another destination is instructed.
Rally is attacking-only and cannot be used by the General while defending.

cases.question: won my first fight defending on their turn. command?

semanticCriteria.statement: Military gains 1 Command for its first battle win of the turn even when that win occurs while defending on the opponent's turn.

cases.question: they refused my deal then fight ended no winner. do i lose the stake

semanticCriteria.statement: The Stake is returned when a battle after refused Terms ends without a winner.

cases.question: got treaty number 6 in denouement. win now?

semanticCriteria.statement: The Diplomat does not win immediately upon getting the sixth different ratified Proposal during Denouement.
Peace Treaty is checked at the start of the Diplomat's turn after Capture and before Draw.

cases.question: income put me over capital cap. lose it right away?

semanticCriteria.statement: Capital may remain above the limit temporarily and is not immediately reduced after Income.
The reduction to the current limit occurs at the end of a turn.

cases.question: they captured land i have the deed for. do they get my deed too

semanticCriteria.statement: Capturing or controlling the Territory does not transfer ownership of its Deed.

cases.question: mission condition is done. does it finish itself

semanticCriteria.statement: A satisfied Active Mission does not complete automatically; completing it requires the normal Denouement Action.

cases.question: their tactic came in face up. can i interfere without surveilling it

semanticCriteria.statement: Intelligence may directly Interfere with an opposing face-up Tactic at the relevant response timing without using Surveillance first.
Direct Interference costs 2 Intel for the card.

cases.question: i transmuted a card. do i get the text on the card too

semanticCriteria.statement: A card used for Transmutation is not played and its printed effects do not apply.

cases.question: blood rite, no gambit no tactic but i transmuted. can the rite still finish

semanticCriteria.statement: Using Transmutation does not by itself prevent Rite of Blood from completing if the Mystic wins without setting a Gambit or choosing a Tactic.

cases.question: i lost. their tactic still gets condemned?

semanticCriteria.statement: Condemnation still sends the opposing Tactic to the Graveyard during the Aftermath even when the Inquisition loses.

cases.question: final judgment purge uses my action?

semanticCriteria.statement: The Purge performed by Final Judgment does not spend an Action.

cases.question: card effect captures their last territory in aftermath. game over now?

semanticCriteria.statement: A legal capture of the opponent's final Territory immediately wins the game even when caused by a card effect during the Aftermath.

cases.question: two different cards both gave advantage. is that double advantage

semanticCriteria.statement: Two separate uncancelled instances of advantage stack to double advantage.
Two net advantage means roll three dice and use the highest result.
